title.zh: v2.0.41 虚拟键盘 100% 水平全宽响应、卷帘全屏防遮挡与全域置顶、悬浮按键与移动端精简控制条
title.en: v2.0.41 Virtual Keyboard 100% Responsive Width, Fullscreen Non-Obscured Z-Index, FAB Toggle & Mobile Quick Control Bar

highlights.zh: **虚拟键盘 100% 水平全宽响应式自适应（100% Responsive Width Keybed）**：彻底消除虚拟键盘两侧留白与宽度受限问题。容器设置 100% 全宽并针对桌面端设置 1200px 黄金居中最大宽度，白键采用 flex: 1 0 auto 均分宽度并设立最小触控安全边界；黑键根据白键边界精准计算居中位置与 60% 相对黄金键宽，完美适配从超宽带鱼屏到掌上触屏设备的各种视口。
highlights.en: **100% Responsive Width Keybed**: Eliminated fixed modal width clamping and horizontal margin gaps. The virtual keyboard container now fills 100% width up to 1200px desktop max-width, with white keys equally dividing space via flex: 1 0 auto and black keys positioned dynamically on white key boundaries with 60% relative width.

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘全屏防遮挡与全域最高置顶（Fullscreen Non-Obscured & Fixed Top Layer）**：将虚拟键盘（Musical Typing）提升为全站绝对最高层级（z-index: 9999），固定吸附于屏幕最底端。当钢琴卷帘进入全屏模式（z-[60]）时，虚拟键盘依然清晰可见、随时弹奏，彻底消除了全屏模式下键盘被遮挡无法演奏的体验断层。
highlights.en: **Fullscreen Non-Obscured & Fixed Top Layer**: Elevated the virtual keyboard modal to the absolute top layer (z-index: 9999) fixed to the bottom edge. When the piano roll expands to fullscreen (z-[60]), the keyboard remains prominently visible and playable without being covered.

highlights.zh: **虚拟键盘右下角悬浮键（FAB）与全局设置开关**：在工作台右下方增设专属圆形琴键悬浮键（FAB，带微光阴影与悬停放大动效），轻点即可随时展开虚拟键盘；键盘展开时自动让位。在「全局设置 → 界面设置」中新增「显示虚拟键盘悬浮键」持久化开关，随心定制操作习惯。
highlights.en: **Virtual Keyboard Floating Action Button (FAB) & Settings Switch**: Added a dedicated circular keyboard FAB on the bottom-right for instant 1-click keyboard launching. Includes a persistent toggle in "Global Settings -> Interface Defaults" to customize workspace density.
